subject.title: Anthropic rejects when multiple tool_result are split across separate messages

question: Should maintainers keep this as a ClawHub cross-repo tracker or move/mirror it to the OpenClaw runtime/provider tracker where the Anthropic transcript serializer lives?
rationale: The report is actionable, but the code path needed to fix or reproduce it is not present in the ClawHub checkout, so automation cannot choose the repository-routing outcome safely.

options.title: Route to OpenClaw runtime
options.body: Move or mirror the report to the runtime/provider tracker and keep this issue linked as context until the runtime fix lands.

options.title: Keep as ClawHub tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open in ClawHub as a cross-repo tracker, accepting that the fix itself cannot be made in this repository.

recommendation.title: Route to OpenClaw runtime
recommendation.body: Move or mirror the report to the runtime/provider tracker and keep this issue linked as context until the runtime fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Current ClawHub scope and package/provider metadata blame points here as the best available routing contact, while the actual runtime owner is not identifiable from this checkout.
